technical_symbols.visual_reference: [IMAGE_014: Table of PLE standard circuit symbols]
technical_symbols.Ammeters: Must be connected in Series to measure flow (Amps).
technical_symbols.Voltmeters: Must be connected in Parallel to measure pressure (Volts).
technical_symbols.Fuses: Represented by a rectangle with a wire line through it.

key_definitions.EMF_Electromotive_Force: The total electrical pressure produced by a source.
key_definitions.Resistance: The opposition to current. Long, thin wires have more resistance than short, thick ones.
key_definitions.Open_vs_Closed: Closed = On (complete path). Open = Off (gap in path).
